gems.title: 欢迎来龙餐馆
gems.titleEn: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
gems.summary: 徐福为养家还债远赴中东中餐馆当厨师，在当地结识了大堂经理马俊生。他们以地道中国风味广招八方来客，龙餐馆声名鹊起。然而随着战争爆发，当地形势急转直下，没有人能够独善其身，徐福和马俊生也不例外，他们的命运将何去何从？战火中的龙餐馆又将如何维系？
gems.summaryEn: Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef in a Chinese restaurant to pay off family debts, where he meets floor manager Ma Junsheng. Their Dragon Restaurant rises to fame, attracting crowds w
gems.whyWatch: 高口碑的战争题材黑马，以中餐馆为窗，照见乱世中小人物的命运。
gems.whyWatchEn: A high-scoring war drama hidden gem set in a Chinese restaurant, capturing ordinary lives caught in a maelstrom of conflict.
gems.audience: 喜欢战争、历史与人性深度的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of war, history, and human drama

gems.title: 维什瓦纳特父子
gems.summary: 桑贾伊·维什瓦纳特是一位备受赞誉的专业手枪射击运动员，年过四十，在名利场上可谓功成名就。然而，当他与二十多岁的女孩玛迪相遇后，两人之间因较大的年龄差距产生了种种碰撞与问题，迫使他们不得不重新审视并坦然面对。
gems.summaryEn: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that th
gems.whyWatch: 印度版忘年恋佳作，运动名将的中年危机与少女情感碰撞出真实火花。
gems.whyWatchEn: A refreshing Indian romance about a celebrated athlete and a young woman, exploring age gap and emotional reinvention.
gems.audience: 喜欢情感冲突与中年爱情故事的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who enjoy emotional conflict and mature romance

gems.title: 属于我的孩子
gems.summary: 在这部令人震惊的纪录片中，承受家人和社会的期望的女子迫切地想要个孩子，因此假装怀孕，并卷入一起犯罪。
gems.summaryEn: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.
gems.whyWatch: 令人不寒而栗的真实罪案纪录片，假怀孕背后是家庭与社会期待的窒息压力。
gems.whyWatchEn: A shocking true-crime documentary about a fake pregnancy and a crime driven by crushing social and family pressure.
gems.audience: 真实犯罪与社会议题爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Fans of true crime and social issues

gems.title: 我们未曾有过的
gems.summary: 改编自爱丽丝·凯伦（Alice Kellen）同名畅销小说。失去父母后，有志成为画家的利亚（Leah）难以应对。当她的哥哥搬走后，他请最好的朋友阿克塞尔（Axel）照顾她，却不知道她对他一直以来的感情。
gems.summaryEn: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grap
gems.whyWatch: 畅销小说改编的细腻虐心爱情，暗恋与失去在青春余韵中悄然生长。
gems.whyWatchEn: A tender and heartbreaking romance adaptation about grief, unrequited love, and finding yourself through loss.
gems.audience: 喜欢细腻情感与青春遗憾故事的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of delicate emotions and bittersweet coming-of-age love

gems.title: 斯图尔特未能拯救宇宙
gems.titleEn: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
gems.summary: 故事聚焦《大爆炸》的漫画书老板斯图尔特·布鲁姆，他弄坏了一个谢尔顿和莱纳德制造的设备，意外导致了多元宇宙的世界末日，他必须与女友Denise、地质学家Bert和量子物理学家Barry一起去将现实复原。一路上，他们遇到了平行宇宙版本的各个《大爆炸》角色，事情进展并不顺利。
gems.summaryEn: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.
gems.whyWatch: 《生活大爆炸》衍生喜剧竟达9分，漫画店老板意外拯救多元宇宙，爆笑又惊喜。
gems.whyWatchEn: A surprisingly excellent Big Bang Theory spin-off with a 9.0 score, turning a comic-book store owner into a multiverse-saving unlikely hero.
gems.audience: 《生活大爆炸》粉丝与科幻喜剧爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Big Bang Theory fans and lovers of sci-fi sitcoms

gems.title: 绿灯军团
gems.summary: 跟随约翰·斯图尔特与绿灯军团传奇哈尔·乔丹的脚步，看这两位星际警察如何深入美国腹地，调查一起谋杀命案。
gems.summaryEn: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.
gems.whyWatch: DC绿灯侠终于有了剧集质感，星际警察深入美国腹地破案，悬疑感拉满。
gems.whyWatchEn: A fresh DC drama following Green Lanterns on a murder investigation in the American heartland—mysterious, grounded, and visually compelling.
gems.audience: DC粉丝与科幻探案爱好者
gems.audienceEn: DC fans and sci-fi mystery buffs

gems.title: 重器
gems.summary: 以改革开放初期至1997年《刑诉法》《刑法》修订为背景，讲述陈一众、余高远、张丽慧、夏英杰等法学院毕业生在不同司法岗位上历经风雨、共同见证中国法治发展进程的故事，展现他们在时代浪潮中成长、抉择与命运交织的群像篇章。
gems.summaryEn: In the early years of China's reform and opening-up, five law school graduates—Chen Yizhong, Yu Gaoyuan, Lu Zeming, Xia Yingjie, and Zhang Lihui—embarked on diverse careers within the judicial system.
gems.whyWatch: 认真讲述中国法治进程的年代律政剧，人物与时代命运交织，厚重而难得。
gems.whyWatchEn: A rare Chinese legal drama spanning decades of judicial reform, weaving personal choices with the nation's legal evolution.
gems.audience: 关心法治进程与年代史诗的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers interested in legal history and epic period storytelling

gems.title: 仙逆
gems.summary: 改编自耳根同名小说《仙逆》，讲述了乡村平凡少年王林以心中之感动，逆仙而修，求的不仅是长生，更多的是摆脱那背后的蝼蚁之身。他坚信道在人为，以平庸的资质踏入修真仙途，历经坎坷风雨，凭着其聪睿的心智，一步一步走向巅峰，凭一己之力，扬名修真界。
gems.summaryEn: It tells the story of Wang Lin, an ordinary young man in the countryside, who is moved by his heart and cultivates against immortality. His pursuit is not only for longevity, but also for getting rid
gems.whyWatch: 国漫修仙代表作，平凡少年逆天改命，剧情与制作都远超预期。
gems.whyWatchEn: A standout Chinese animated cultivation saga about an ordinary boy defying fate—with impressive storytelling and production quality.
gems.audience: 修仙玄幻与国漫爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Fans of cultivation fantasy and Chinese animation

gems.title: 无职转生～到了异世界就拿出真本事～
gems.summary: “我要在这个异世界拿出真本事！”34岁童贞且无职的家里蹲男子，在父母的葬礼当天被赶出家门后，在路上被一辆卡车所撞死。意识清醒后，他发现自己居然作为一个刚出生的婴儿转生到了剑与魔法的异世界！像废物一样活过了前世的男子，发誓要作为少年·鲁迪乌斯在异世界以认真的态度好好活下去！等待着鲁迪乌斯的是，与娇小魔术师、有着精灵长耳又很男孩子气的美少女、凶暴的傲娇大小姐以及其他性格各异的人们之间的邂逅，当然也还有
gems.summaryEn: When a 34-year-old underachiever gets run over by a truck, his story doesn't end there. Reincarnated in a new world as an infant, Rudy will seize every opportunity to live the life he's always wanted.
gems.whyWatch: 异世界番剧天花板之一，从废柴到认真活过的重生成长，情感扎实后劲足。
gems.whyWatchEn: A definitive isekai anime about a shut-in reborn in another world, delivering sincere growth, stunning animation, and deep emotional resonance.
gems.audience: 异世界奇幻与成长故事爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Fans of isekai fantasy and character-driven stories
